name: catalog_record_references
description: The record a record's REFERENCE field points to, mirrored from the record values so deleting the target can be refused.
lifecycle: Replaced with the record's values in the same transaction; deleted with the referring record.

columns.Meaning: Company that owns the catalog (tenant key).
Catalog of the record, kept for per-catalog and per-field lookups; the module keeps it equal to the record's catalog.
Record the value points to, in the field's target catalog.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, catalog_id) REFERENCES catalogs(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The catalog belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, field_id) REFERENCES catalog_fields(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The field belongs to the same company; the module checks it belongs to the record's catalog.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, record_id) REFERENCES catalog_records(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.Purpose: The referring record belongs to the same company; rows are deleted with it.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, target_record_id) REFERENCES catalog_records(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The target is a record of the same company that cannot be deleted while referenced.
One reference per record and field.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX catalog_record_references_target_idx ON public.catalog_record_references USING btree (company_id, target_record_id)
constraints.Purpose: Counts the records that refer to a record.
